issues.title: Partial refunds drop the whole order
issues.explanation: r.id IS NULL removes any order with any refund, so a $5 refund on a $500 order loses $500 of revenue. Spec says subtract refunds.
issues.fix: Subtract refunded amounts: aggregate refunds per order in a subquery and use o.total - COALESCE(refunded, 0).

issues.title: Months bucketed in UTC
issues.explanation: date_trunc on a timestamptz uses the session time zone, not Asia/Singapore, so orders near midnight land in the wrong month.

issues.title: Not 12 full months
issues.explanation: now() - 12 months includes the current partial month and part of the month 12 months ago.
issues.fix: Bound by date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Singapore') minus 12 months, exclusive of the current month.
